title: Environmental behaviors and ecological risks of organophosphate esters in a metropolitan river system of the Pearl River Basin, South China
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00580A, Paper
Xuemin Hu, Zhongwen Li, Kaiyi Wu, Zhenkui Huang, Yingchun Xie, Haonan Li, Jiahui Zhang, Junli Wang, Jing Zheng
Organophosphate esters (OPEs) are ubiquitous hazardous chemicals in metropolitan river systems. This study focused on their occurrence, partitioning behaviors, source attributions, and ecological risks in metropolitan rivers of South China.
